# Vector Store

A vector store is a system for persisting and retrieving high-dimensional
numerical vectors (embeddings).

Capabilities:
- Persists embedding vectors with associated metadata
- Supports ANN (approximate nearest-neighbour) lookups
- Used in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines
- Examples: ChromaDB, FAISS, Qdrant, Pinecone

A vector store allows semantic similarity queries by measuring distances
between vectors — typically using cosine similarity.

See also: [[vector-database]].
